en: But hey! Energy so big it can't grow fast enough to keep up... $s80$s13something like that$s30...$s80$s13!
$s05No way!
$s05The Getter! $s80$s13We fly the Getter inside its body and blast it with Getter Energy at maximum output!
That's right!$/But while it's inside, that Getter will be completely defenseless! $s80$s13The remaining Getters must stand guard over it! $s80$s13$s05Can you manage it!?
It's the only way, isn't it!? $s80$s13You don't even need to ask!$/$m00g$s05Let's go!
Hm? $s80$s13$s80$s13So you came after all, Getter Team.
$s05Ngh! $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13To think there was a way to do that!
note: Bat reacting to the Getter attacking Gera from inside.

en: $s20Today is the day you all die!
That's right!$/All right, $s80$s13Getter Team, withdraw at once. $s80$s13We'll regroup and sortie again!
$s05Curse you! $s80$s13Curse you, Getter Robo! $s80$s13$s05Gwaaaah!

Get inside the beast's body, $s80$s13and hold out there!$/$s80$s13Will the Getter be turned into energy first, $s80$s13or will the Getter's energy break the beast down first...$s80$s13$s05It's a showdown!
$/Having lost Getter Robo, the Getter Team could do nothing but watch as Gera swallowed up the city...
This here's MAP05, pal!
Multiple readings over the Pacific! $s80$s13They appear to be Dinosaur Empire Mechasaurs!
Man, would you look at how many there are!
$s20So those Dinosaur Empire bastards $s80$s13$s80$s13are finally getting serious, huh!
$s20We cannot let them into the city! $s80$s13We'll meet them on the coastline!
$s05Damn it! $s80$s13$s05These dino bastards! $s80$s13$s05There's too many of them to handle!
$s05There are so many dinosaurs! $s80$s13$s05I can't handle them anymore!
$s05We've got a reading on radar!
$s80$s13$s05Wh-- $s80$s13$s05More of 'em coming!?
$s05No, that's not it!
Whoa! $s80$s13What is that thing!?
$s30That's $s80$s13the large transport plane Kujira!
So you've come! $s80$s13Dr. Tachibana!
$s30...! $s80$s13%1Getter Zan%0!
Nice to meet you! $s80$s13%1Getter Zan%0!
Getter Team, $s80$s13launch!
It's %2a Getter Robo built for women only%0.$/I built it so it can be expected to match the fighting strength of Dr. Saotome's Getter Robo. $s80$s13Use it to fight your way out of this!
Bring any damaged units over to the Kujira! $s80$s13If you %2'Board'%0 them here, they can be repaired and resupplied!

en: This here's MAP06, pal!
$s20As you all know, a new enemy, $s20the %3Hyakki Empire%0, appeared in the last battle.
When sparks fall on you$s30...$s80$s13 huh?
Yes, $s80$s13you must brush them off.
An allied force...?

That's right. $s80$s13Besides Getter Robo, nations all over the world are developing super robots.$/But development takes enormous funding and manpower, and above all, there aren't enough engineers.$/So no nation has managed to mass-produce super robots yet.
And we went and smashed the mass-produced Getter Robos too, after all.
note: Refers to the mass-produced Getters hijacked by Neon in MF03.

en: Losing that much fighting strength really stings!
It kind of feels like such a waste, doesn't it?
Besides, a single unit may be able to defend, but going on the offensive is difficult.
So when's that going to happen?
Every nation is still in the preparation stage.$/It will take a while yet, but it isn't far off.
And then, for the first time, we can take the fight to them!
$s05Dr. Tachibana! $s05The Hyakki Empire is attacking the Tachibana Institute!
$s05What!?
$s05No way! $s80$s13$s05They're targeting a Getter Ray research institute!?
$s05Could it be...! $s80$s13$s05They're targeting a Getter Ray research institute!?
$s05That's not all! $s80$s13$s05Right now at the institute, a new Getter Robo, $/%1Getter Robo Go%0, is just about to be completed!
$s05All Getter Robos! $s80$s13$s05Launch to rescue the Tachibana Institute!
Listen up! This time our objective is to defend the institute!$/$s05$m01gDon't let them get a single step closer!
Long time no see! $s80$s13Hayato!
$s05!? $s80$s13That voice! $s80$s13$s05Ryuji!
So you still remember me...
Ryuji! You...$s80$s13why...
$s20After you left the school, $s80$s13$s20we lost you, our commander, $s80$s13and the school took its revenge on us in all kinds of ways.
$s05Ryuji!
$s05Dr. Tachibana, $s80$s13can't Getter Go move yet!?
If we don't hurry, everyone's gonna--!
Almost! $s80$s13Just a little longer!
$s05Father! $s80$s13$s05Hurry!
$s20That isn't what you wanted, was it... $s80$s13Power that does nothing but destroy...
note: Hayato to Ryuji, answering Ryuji's 'I wanted power' (MF06_099F).

en: $s05Damn it! $s80$s13$s05Even more small fry showed up!
$s05Isn't it ready yet!? $s80$s13$s05The Getter Go!
$s05Everyone! $s80$s13We're getting a distress signal from the Saotome Institute!
$s05What did you say!?
So the attack here is a diversion!?
No, I can't tell. $s80$s13The attack on the Saotome Institute might be the diversion!
$s05$n! What do we do!?
note: Ryoma asks the player to make the call (route choice follows).

en: $s20They have already declared war on every nation in the world, $s80$s13$s20and the fighting has begun.
But $s80$s13$s20just as with the Dinosaur Empire, $s80$s13$s20what we must do remains the same.
Soon, we plan to gather %1super robots%0 from nations all over the world $s80$s13and form an allied force.
I see, so that's what the allied force is for.
$s20And many of our friends quit the school...
I wanted power! $s80$s13Power that would never bow to anyone!
$s20And I got it! $s80$s13The power called Maouki! $s80$s13$s80$s13Yes! $s80$s13From the Hyakki Empire, $s80$s13from His Majesty Emperor Burai!
